periods.time: One week after Or-Gaule's Marionette collapse

name.zh: 特别徵召重捕九成越狱犯
name.en: Special conscription recaptures most escaped prisoners

periods.summary: Or-Gaule's forced release of Marionette control causes government and prison systems worldwide to fail, triggering mass prison breaks. Acting for the absent Prime Minister Tsukikage, Itsuki Kurogane issues special conscription, giving student knights temporary mage-knight authority. With students such as Toka's Hagun group, Amane, Moroboshi, Kiriko and others, Japan recaptures over ninety percent of escaped prisoners within a week.
periods.cause: Or-Gaule withdraws control from officials and workers worldwide, causing simultaneous security breakdowns and escaped Blazer criminals.
periods.process: Itsuki judges that the crisis requires expanding manpower immediately and authorizes students to use magic and fight in public. Student knights suppress hijackings, dojo attacks, underground arenas and other incidents while professional mage-knights regain control.
periods.outcome: Japan stabilizes faster than other countries, allowing the League Japan Branch to end special conscription and return remaining fugitive pursuit to professionals.
periods.significance: Provides the volume's crisis backdrop and positions the current student generation as a golden generation capable of real emergency work.
